synthetic_environment.scope: Identical recorded predictions drive four independently counterbalanced synthetic in-memory mappings per EEG record through one fixed16-prompt routing cache. This separately named five-model replay preserves all original source, prediction and report bytes. The four mappings are not independent EEG samples.

limitations: New models reuse the already observed test cohort exploratorily. Scientific design was fixed before phase2 test; no result-driven fitting or threshold changes.
Initial epoch0 was an explicit SSL validation candidate; reconstruction improvement is not proof of MI decoding or agent-task improvement.

Compare matched data, split and architecture while reporting actual training epochs/time; phase2 fused was time-limited, so different optimization budgets are not isolated as an SSL-only causal effect.
The fixed0.8 threshold is a restricted binary softmax threshold, not calibrated intention confidence.
Subject bootstrap conditions on these selected weights; training-seed variability and multiplicity are not covered.
T0 is instructed rest and the harness is a bounded synthetic task using public cue labels; neither is natural autonomous operation.
Four environment mappings reuse each EEG sample.16actual frozen-LLM routing calls are cached for replay; old-model EEG inference is not repeated.
Prepared SSL duration, completed-step seen duration, selected-encoder duration and combined selected downstream path interval unions are separate quantities.
